# {{modName}}

Minecraft {{mcVersion}} / Forge {{loaderVersion}} mod, generated by mcmodkit from a ModSpec.

## Build

```
gradlew.bat build      # Windows
./gradlew build        # macOS / Linux
```

The mod jar is written to build/libs/. Requires JDK {{javaVersion}}; the bundled Gradle wrapper ({{gradleWrapperVersion}}) downloads dependencies on first run.

{{TEXTURE_NOTES}}

## Regenerating

Files listed in the mcmodkit plan are managed and overwritten on regeneration; anything else in this
project is never touched. Re-run `mcmod gen <spec.json> -o .` from the framework repository.

public static final Block {{CONST_UPPER}} = register("{{REG_NAME}}", new Block({{SETTINGS}}).setHardness({{HARDNESS}}F).setResistance({{RESISTANCE}}F), "{{tool}}");
	public static final Item {{CONST_UPPER}}_ITEM = registerItem({{CONST_UPPER}});

notes: Forge 1.20.1 uses the pre-1.21 PLURAL datapack directories: data/<ns>/loot_tables/blocks/... and data/minecraft/tags/blocks/mineable/... The singular 1.21 names do not load here.
Mappings are Mojang official (channel 'official'); API names are mojmap (net.minecraft.world.item.Item), not MCP/yarn.
Mod metadata lives in src/main/resources/META-INF/mods.toml; the @Mod annotated class is discovered by scanning, so mods.toml does not name it.
Version facts: Forge 1.20.1 recommended 47.4.10 (files.minecraftforge.net promotions_slim.json), ForgeGradle 6.0.54, Gradle 8.8 wrapper as shipped by the official 47.4.10 MDK.
Textures are not generated: add 16x16 PNGs under assets/<ns>/textures/{item,block}/<id>.png.

Compile-verified trap: ItemLike is net.minecraft.world.level.ItemLike on 1.20.1 (verified with javap against the mapped Forge jar) and stays there on 1.21.1; net.minecraft.world.item.ItemLike does not exist on either version.
Compile-verified: ResourceLocation.fromNamespaceAndPath(namespace, path) exists in 1.20.1 and avoids the deprecated public ResourceLocation(String, String) constructor.

Registry lookups must not happen in register(): it runs from the mod constructor, before any RegisterEvent populates the DeferredRegister. TAB_ENTRIES therefore holds RegistryObject suppliers and resolves them lazily inside the creative-tab lambdas. Calling .get() there throws "Registry Object not present: <ns>:<id>" at load time.

com.mojang.logging.LogUtils is not in the 1.16.5 jar (1.17+); the mod class logs through org.apache.logging.log4j.LogManager. The @Mod class also takes a no-arg constructor and reaches the event bus through FMLJavaModLoadingContext.get() - constructor injection is much newer.

com.mojang.logging.LogUtils is not in the 1.16.5 jar (1.17+); the mod class logs through org.apache.logging.log4j.LogManager. The @Mod class takes a no-arg constructor and reaches the event bus through FMLJavaModLoadingContext.get() - constructor injection is much newer.
Derived from forge-1.16.5, re-fitted with facts from scripts/version-facts.mjs (loader 14.23.5.2864, pack_format ? read from the real game jar).

SCOPE: items + blocks + textures only. UI/recipes/advancements/entities/datagen are deliberately absent because their templates are not version-independent (1.21.2+ alone changed MobRenderer's arity and EntityType.Builder#build). Asking for them fails with a clear error rather than emitting broken Java.

This is the oldest target in the repo and shares almost nothing with the others. It uses MCP names, RegistryEvent.Register<T> instead of DeferredRegister, item setters (setMaxStackSize/setMaxDamage/setCreativeTab) instead of an Item.Properties object, mcmod.info instead of mods.toml, and MCP snapshot mappings instead of Mojang's.

1.12.2 has NO datapack tags and NO block loot tables (tags are 1.13+, block loot tables 1.14+). This adapter therefore declares neither, so the generator emits neither: the harvest tool is set in code with Block#setHarvestLevel, and a plain Block drops itself with no data file.

Resources live under assets/<namespace>/, not data/<namespace>/ (data packs are 1.13+), texture directories are PLURAL (textures/items/, textures/blocks/ - singular from 1.13), and model parents carry no "minecraft:" prefix. All read from the real 1.12.2 client jar.

Lang keys are item.<name>.name and tile.<name>.name: Item.getUnlocalizedName() prepends "item.", Block's prepends "tile.", and ItemStack appends ".name". The block's ItemBlock inherits the block's key, so one entry covers both.

Toolchain: ForgeGradle 3 (the official 1.12.x MDK uses 3.+, not 2.3) with the Gradle 4.10.3 wrapper and a Java 8 daemon - Gradle 4.10.3 does not start on Java 9+. ForgeGradle 6 cannot build this version (it fails inside its own toolchain handling on Gradle 8), and ForgeGradle 2.3 cannot either: Forge no longer publishes a -userdev.jar for 1.12.2.
